items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Because I always wondered how much Norman Granz was behind all that.

ctx.x: It looked like Ray Brown won the bass poll for about the last 20 years. That was his thing. And I don't think that was fair because that showed me that there wasn't nobody listening at nobody else.
Because I always wondered how much Norman Granz was behind all that.
See, just write a check man, write a check. And that would straighten out all of that stuff.
